message.content: Build an award-worthy site for a small Antarctic expedition operator called Southbound (six guests per trip, two camps, flights from Cape Town), in the current directory. Vanilla Vite, no CMS. Work through the full awards process and write AWARDS.md and DESIGN.md as you go. Do not ask me questions; make and record your assumptions.

content.text: The brief, the direction contract and the visual system are done. AWARDS.md has the brief and the locked contract (the weather window as the product, seed k3v9q2m7x1pd), and DESIGN.md has the tokens. The next phase is the page structure.
